method: WAC (Wins Above Contender): for each game, result minus the chance a Contender (a team at the 75th-percentile OVR of the team's own class) would win that game; summed over the season. Quads use the 75/50/25th percentile OVR of the team's own class. SOS = average opponent OVR, ranked within class. Current ratings; regular season + postseason. Out-of-state / non-MSHSAA opponents and forfeits not counted (overall record includes them). Projected seed = 60% WAC + 40% OVR (district percentiles), then head-to-head jumps.
